findings.summary: The base-ref lookup fails open. If neither origin/main nor main resolves, it prints a notice and skips the growth check. CI uses fetch-depth: 0, so this is fine there.
findings.title: scripts/check-parity.mjs: the base-ref lookup fails open. if neither origin/main nor main resolves, it prints a notice and skips the growth check. ci uses fetch-depth: 0, so this is fine there.

findings.summary: The 'defined' check is a substring match of the quoted name against the whole SDK file; a name in a comment counts as defined. The Go test has the same weakness.
findings.title: sdk-python/tests/test_parity.py: the 'defined' check is a substring match of the quoted name against the whole sdk file; a name in a comment counts as defined. the go test has the same weakness.

findings.summary: Extraction relies on text markers; the generator throws when one is missing, which is the right failure mode.
findings.title: scripts/generate-parity-manifest.mjs: extraction relies on text markers; the generator throws when one is missing, which is the right failure mode.

findings.summary: The git-based base lookup and the CLI main() path are not exercised by tests; they are thin wrappers.
findings.title: scripts/check-parity.test.mjs: the git-based base lookup and the cli main() path are not exercised by tests; they are thin wrappers.

findings.summary: Both SDK tests check a name by substring match on the quoted string in one source file; acceptable for a parity guard and consistent between the suites.
findings.title: sdk-python/tests/test_parity.py: both sdk tests check a name by substring match on the quoted string in one source file; acceptable for a parity guard and consistent between the suites.

findings.summary: If neither origin/main nor main resolves, the exemptions-only-shrink check is skipped with a console.log, so the job still passes. Consider failing in CI when no base is found.

findings.summary: The --base-ref value goes into git show with no -- and no check for a leading '-'. execFileSync has no shell, so there is no shell injection, and CI never passes the flag.
